module rtlpp_03317(

    input  wire        gmii_rxclk,
    input  wire        gmii_txclk,

    input  wire        rst_n,    
    input  wire        port_type,

    input  wire        gmii_rx_dv,
    input  wire        gmii_rx_er,
    input  wire [7:0]  gmii_rxd,
    
    output  wire        gmii_rx_dv_adp2tsnchip,
    output  wire        gmii_rx_er_adp2tsnchip,
    output  wire [7:0]  gmii_rxd_adp2tsnchip,
        
    output wire        gmii_tx_en,
    output wire        gmii_tx_er,
    output wire [7:0]  gmii_txd,

    input wire        gmii_tx_en_tsnchip2adp,
    input wire        gmii_tx_er_tsnchip2adp,
    input wire [7:0]  gmii_txd_tsnchip2adp

);

/*
            Intermediate variable Declaration
*/
wire       grc2ppt_gmii_dv;
wire       grc2ppt_gmii_er;
wire [7:0] grc2ppt_gmii_data;

wire       ppt2gtc_gmii_dv;
wire       ppt2gtc_gmii_er;
wire [7:0] ppt2gtc_gmii_data;

/*
            gmii_rxctrl_hcp logic
*/
reg        gmii_rx_dv_adp2tsnchip_reg;
reg        gmii_rx_er_adp2tsnchip_reg;
reg [7:0]  gmii_rxd_adp2tsnchip_reg;

always @(posedge gmii_rxclk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        gmii_rx_dv_adp2tsnchip_reg <= 1'b0;
        gmii_rx_er_adp2tsnchip_reg <= 1'b0;
        gmii_rxd_adp2tsnchip_reg   <= 8'b0;
    end else if (port_type) begin // Assuming this is a placeholder for more intricate logic
        gmii_rx_dv_adp2tsnchip_reg <= gmii_rx_dv;
        gmii_rx_er_adp2tsnchip_reg <= gmii_rx_er;
        gmii_rxd_adp2tsnchip_reg   <= gmii_rxd;
    end else begin
        gmii_rx_dv_adp2tsnchip_reg <= 1'b0;
        gmii_rx_er_adp2tsnchip_reg <= 1'b0;
        gmii_rxd_adp2tsnchip_reg   <= 8'b0;
    end
end

assign gmii_rx_dv_adp2tsnchip = gmii_rx_dv_adp2tsnchip_reg;
assign gmii_rx_er_adp2tsnchip = gmii_rx_er_adp2tsnchip_reg;
assign gmii_rxd_adp2tsnchip   = gmii_rxd_adp2tsnchip_reg;

/*
            gmii_txctrl_hcp logic
*/
reg        gmii_tx_en_reg;
reg        gmii_tx_er_reg;
reg [7:0]  gmii_txd_reg;

always @(posedge gmii_txclk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        gmii_tx_en_reg <= 1'b0;
        gmii_tx_er_reg <= 1'b0;
        gmii_txd_reg   <= 8'b0;
    end else begin
        gmii_tx_en_reg <= gmii_tx_en_tsnchip2adp;
        gmii_tx_er_reg <= gmii_tx_er_tsnchip2adp;
        gmii_txd_reg   <= gmii_txd_tsnchip2adp;
    end
end

assign gmii_tx_en = gmii_tx_en_reg;
assign gmii_tx_er = gmii_tx_er_reg;
assign gmii_txd   = gmii_txd_reg;

endmodule
